$comment: R35 (P2/P3): canonical module -> configuration dependency manifest. Read by scripts/feature-readiness.mjs (read-only doctor) and checked by tests/unit/r35-activation-manifest.test.js against the environment reads of the code (scripts/lib/env-inventory.mjs) and against the owner guide. Names only, never values. 'gaps' are implementation gaps that close themselves when the 'fixed_when' pattern appears in the file. 'gates' are legal / privacy / owner decisions; the doctor never clears one: a gate is cleared only by its approval variable or by an explicit owner decision recorded here with a date.
